MORE THAN A SALON

A family legacy.
A feeling of belonging.

Founded by David Berry and grown alongside Angela Berry, Pure Body has been part of Charlotte’s beauty story for over four decades.

Today, our historic home near Wesley Heights brings a welcoming salon and independent beauty suites together. It’s a place for great hair, familiar faces, and the next generation of beauty professionals.

Come experience Pure Body
